d: Bihar Free Electricity Scheme : bihar men 125 yunit mupht bijli yojna ko lekar ek naee bahas chhir gaee hai... karib 1 karor 92 lakh parivaron ko har mahine mil rahi mupht bijli ke bich mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne sanpann parivaron aur inkam taiks dene valon se sabsidi chhorne ki apil ki hai... iske lie sarkar 1 disanbar se vishesh abhiyan shuru karne ja rahi hai... mukhyamantri ka kahna hai ki bijli sabsidi par har sal karib 23 hajar karor rupye kharch ho rahe hain... aise men saval hai ki kya bihar men mupht bijli yojna ka bhavishy badalne vala hai... kya sarkar sabsidi ka bojh kam…
